title: The Kenyan Ranger Who Risks His Life to Save Rare Animal He’s Seen Once

sentences: A Kenyan ranger who devoted his life to protecting an animal so rare that he has caught only a fleeting glimpse of it will receive an award for his conservation efforts.
translations: 一位肯尼亚护林员将因其保护工作获得奖项，他毕生致力于保护一种极其罕见的动物，以至于只匆匆瞥见过它一眼。

sentences: Laban Mwangi, 43, has spent two decades trying to save the mountain bongo from extinction.
The striking striped forest antelope once roamed Kenya in great numbers but has dwindled to fewer than 40 in the wild.
translations: 43岁的拉班·姆万吉花了二十年时间试图拯救山地邦戈羚羊免于灭绝。
这种引人注目的条纹森林羚羊曾经在肯尼亚大量出没，但在野外已减少到不足40只。

sentences: In his work, Mwangi has clashed with poachers and cut thousands of snares in the Aberdare and Maasai Mau forests.

With almost no sightings of the antelope, Mwangi and his team from the Mountain Bongo Project (MBP) rely on tracks, dung and the odd camera-trap image as the only evidence that the animals are still holding on in the mountains.
translations: 在工作中，姆万吉曾与偷猎者发生冲突，并在阿伯德尔和马赛马乌森林中切断了数千个陷阱。
由于几乎看不到这种羚羊，姆万吉和他的山地邦戈项目（MBP）团队只能依靠足迹、粪便和偶尔的相机陷阱图像，作为这些动物仍在山区存活的唯一证据。

sentences: "I want to save the mountain bongo for Kenya and for my own children to see them one day," Mwangi said.

He grew up on stories from his father, who in the 1970s had been paid to capture live bongos to supply foreign zoos but later switched to protecting them, becoming the first tracker for the MBP when it was established in 2003.
Laban joined him in the organisation two years later as one of its first rangers, rising through the ranks to become head ranger.
translations: "我想为肯尼亚拯救山地邦戈，也让我的孩子们有一天能看到它们，"姆万吉说道。
他从小听着父亲的故事长大，父亲在20世纪70年代曾受雇捕捉活邦戈以供应外国动物园，但后来转而保护它们，并在2003年山地邦戈保护计划成立时成为首位追踪员。
两年后，拉班加入该组织，成为首批护林员之一，并逐步晋升为首席护林员。

sentences: It is perilous work, spending weeks at a time in dense, mountainous forests, far from his wife and three young children.
The patrols are up against illegal logging, encroachment into central Kenya's fragile ecosystems and poachers armed with guns, spears and dogs.
translations: 这是一项危险的工作，需要连续数周待在茂密的山地森林中，远离妻子和三个年幼的孩子。
巡逻队要对抗非法伐木、对肯尼亚中部脆弱生态系统的侵占，以及携带枪支、长矛和猎犬的偷猎者。

sentences: Mwangi has the scars from one encounter in which he was slashed to the bone by a poacher's machete, requiring days of hospital treatment.
"They are angry with us for destroying their snares and hideouts, but the dangers don't deter us from our work," he said.
translations: 姆万吉身上有一道伤疤，来自一次遭遇，他被偷猎者的砍刀砍到骨头，需要住院治疗数日。
“他们因为我们破坏他们的陷阱和藏身处而生气，但危险并不能阻止我们工作，”他说。

sentences: Risk comes from natural hazards.
"Our patrol was once charged by elephants on a narrow path and the only way we could escape was to climb high enough up trees so they could not pull us down," he said.
translations: 风险来自自然灾害。
“我们的巡逻队曾在小路上遭到大象的冲撞，唯一逃脱的办法是爬到足够高的树上，让它们无法把我们拽下来，”他说。

sentences: During his 20 years with MBP, Mwangi has helped remove more than 2,000 snares, dismantled dozens of elephant traps and made hundreds of arrests related to poaching and illegal logging.
translations: 在MBP工作的20年间，姆万吉协助拆除了2000多个陷阱，捣毁了几十个捕象装置，并逮捕了数百名与偷猎和非法伐木相关的人员。

sentences: The work of guarding bongos, listed by the International Union for Conservation of Nature as critically endangered, has the natural benefit of protecting other vulnerable species that share their habitat, including the extremely rare yellow-backed duikers and giant pangolins.
translations: 保护被国际自然保护联盟列为极度濒危的邦戈羚羊的工作，自然也有助于保护与其共享栖息地的其他脆弱物种，包括极其罕见的黄背小羚羊和巨型穿山甲。

sentences: Mwangi's efforts will be recognised this week when he receives the Tusk Wildlife Ranger Award, most likely from the Prince of Wales, the royal patron of the UK-based conservation charity which helps to fund MBP's work.
translations: 姆旺吉的努力将在本周得到认可，届时他将获得塔斯克野生动物护林员奖，颁奖人很可能是威尔士亲王——这家总部位于英国的保护慈善机构的皇家赞助人，该机构为MBP的工作提供资助。

sentences: Mwangi said the grant attached to the award would go towards equipment, ranger training and working with communities on the forest fringes, helping them find alternative income streams to hunting for the pot and chopping down trees.
The bongos' browsing helps regulate the forest vegetation, promoting diversity and ecological balance.
translations: 姆万吉表示，该奖项附带的资助将用于设备、护林员培训以及与森林边缘社区的合作，帮助他们找到替代狩猎和砍伐树木的收入来源。
邦戈羚羊的觅食有助于调节森林植被，促进多样性和生态平衡。

sentences: Over the years, Mwangi has reached tens of thousands of people to advocate for conserving the forests and their animal populations, including by bringing mountain bongo wildlife clubs to local schools.
translations: 多年来，姆万吉已经接触了数万人，倡导保护森林及其动物种群，包括将山地邦戈野生动物俱乐部引入当地学校。

sentences: We are helping inspire the next generation of rangers.
I tell them we can't wait for someone else to do this work and even their small actions can help,
"I have committed my life to protecting an animal most people will never see.
That makes the work even more important."
translations: 我们正在帮助激励下一代护林员。
我告诉他们，我们不能等待别人来做这项工作，即使他们的小小行动也能有所帮助，
"我毕生致力于保护一种大多数人永远看不到的动物。
这让这项工作更加重要。"

sentences: Since Tusk was founded in 1990 it has generated £130 million to support more than 250 local conservation organisations and ranger teams across Africa.
translations: 自1990年成立以来，Tusk已筹集1.3亿英镑，用于支持非洲各地超过250个当地保护组织和护林员团队。

sentences: In a separate initiative, Kenya's wildlife authority is working to reintroduce a number of bongos from captivity to the wild to help boost its numbers and genetic diversity.
From the original 40 or so animals that were captured and exported, there are approximately 650 being held in facilities in North America and Europe.
Last month, Woburn Safari Park in Bedfordshire announced the birth of a female calf.
translations: 在一项独立的计划中，肯尼亚野生动物管理局正致力于将一批邦戈羚羊从圈养环境重新引入野外，以帮助增加其数量和遗传多样性。
从最初被捕获并出口的大约40只动物开始，目前北美和欧洲的设施中圈养着约650只。
上个月，贝德福德郡的沃本野生动物园宣布诞生了一只雌性幼崽。
